action.message:
Implemented the repair in src/dotenv/parser.py only.

Change: line 30, `_rest_of_line` alternation reordered from `(?:|
|
)?` to `(?:
|
|)?`, so CRLF is matched as a single complete newline (consistent with `_newline` and `_end_of_line`).

Effect: In the error-recovery branch of `parse_binding`, an invalid line followed by CRLF now consumes the whole `
`, so the invalid binding's `original.string` includes the full CRLF and the next valid binding starts at line 2 with `original.string` exactly `GOOD=ok
`. LF and lone-CR handling are unchanged (each still consumes exactly one terminator), and repeated invalid lines remain one binding per line. No tests, docs, other modules, or dependencies were touched.
